title: Leaderboard — signal and staking are scored separately

rules.rule_1: Ranking uses signal columns ONLY. Staking columns are displayed but never change rank.
rules.rule_2: A strategy is reward-eligible only if signal gates pass AND n >= 300 graded selections (G2).
rules.rule_3: Staking results (ROI, bankroll path) cannot offset a failed signal gate; a strong staking run with a failed signal is labelled "signal fail — staking ignored".
rules.rule_4: Missing staking or price data is blank and makes the strategy paper-only, never live.
